newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Tuesday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. April retail sales data, which are forecast to show a decline of 0.3 percent compared with a 0.1 percent gain reported in March.

"Rates were quietly steady in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the retail sales figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday and Wednesday/Thursday were unchanged from Monday's common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
